 Print Rimi Tomy hints at second marriage; reveals someone special entered her life in 2026, says, 'I found. Malayalam singer Rimi Tomy has shared a personal update, revealing that she is preparing to get married for the second time. In a video posted on her YouTube channel, the singer spoke about the person who entered her life in 2026. She said she would reveal more details about the individual later. Rimi Tomy also clarified that her prospective partner is not an actor, singer, celebrity or billionaire. While she did not disclose the person's identity or profession, she spoke about the understanding they had developed and the peace she found in the relationship. Rimi Tomy confirms plans for second marriage 
 The singer said via her YouTube channel that she wanted to share the news with people who have followed her journey over the years. She recalled beginning her stage performances at the age of 16 and making her film singing debut when she was 18. "I came here to share something with you. I started performing in stage shows when I was 16. You have known me through my stage performances since then. I sang my first song for a film when I was 18. From that time until 2026, you have witnessed the events and experiences in my life. My family probably knows me even better than you do." She added that many people who have followed her career have also been curious about her personal life. Rimi Tomy said she decided to share the update because she believed the news would make her well-wishers happy. Singer recalls previous marriage rumours 
 Rimi Tomy also addressed earlier speculation about her marriage. She recalled that reports claiming she was getting married circulated widely around three years ago. At the time, she had released a video denying those reports and asked people not to believe unverified claims. She also remembered asking her followers in a video filmed in Canada whether they would be happy if she decided to marry again. The singer has now shared that she has found someone with whom she wants to take that step. Rimi Tomy speaks about finding a life partner 
 Explaining her decision, Rimi Tomy said she was genuinely happy but had always felt the absence of a partner in her life. "There is absolutely no doubt that I am extremely happy. But there has always been a gap in my life in the form of a partner. Only a partner can fill that space." She revealed that the person entered her life in 2026. Although she promised to share more information later, she made it clear that the individual does not belong to the entertainment industry or come from a wealthy background. Singer says the relationship has brought her peace 
 Rimi Tomy spoke about how spending time with the person helped them understand each other. She said they had become familiar with both the positive and difficult aspects of each other's personalities. "Sometimes, when you meet certain people, talk to them and spend time with them, you feel that God has brought them into your life. You get the feeling that your life, whether professionally or personally, will grow in a positive direction because of them. I felt that way about this person. "Everyone begins life with great expectations. I felt the same way about this relationship. Within a short period, we understood each other's good and bad sides, including our anger, stubbornness, affection, sadness and pride. More than anything else, I found a sense of peace. I decided to take this step when I felt that I could have a good life with this person." Rimi Tomy seeks blessings as wedding plans take shape 
 The singer said she would share updates about her personal life through her official social media platforms. She also expressed hope that the wedding would take place soon, while acknowledging that the final outcome was in God's hands. "Whenever I have something to share, I will do so through my Instagram account and YouTube channel. Please understand that. I hope the wedding will happen soon. Ultimately, everything is in God's hands. I need everyone's prayers, blessings and support." On the professional front, Rimi Tomy's last musical work was for the film 'Mohan Kumar Fans'.
